name: get_project_lead
description: Returns the real project lead's name and status for an exact project name
code:
def get_project_lead(project_name: str) -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement="SELECT lead_name, status FROM workspace.default.projects WHERE name = :project_name LIMIT 1",
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[StatementParameterListItem(name="project_name", value=project_name)],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    if resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED":
        return f"Could not look up project: {resp.status.error.message if resp.status.error else 'unknown error'}"
    rows = resp.result.data_array if resp.result else []
    if not rows:
        return f"No project found named '{project_name}'."
    lead_name, status = rows[0]
    return f"Project '{project_name}' is led by {lead_name} (status: {status})."

name: get_lead_workload
description: Given a project lead's exact name, returns how many projects they currently lead
code:
def get_lead_workload(lead_name: str) -> str:
    from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementParameterListItem
    warehouse_id = next(w.warehouses.list()).id
    resp = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        statement="SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.default.projects WHERE lead_name = :lead_name",
        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
        parameters=[StatementParameterListItem(name="lead_name", value=lead_name)],
        wait_timeout="30s",
    )
    if resp.status and resp.status.state.value == "FAILED":
        return f"Could not look up workload: {resp.status.error.message if resp.status.error else 'unknown error'}"
    rows = resp.result.data_array if resp.result else []
    count = rows[0][0] if rows else 0
    return f"{lead_name} currently leads {count} project(s)."
